moments.title: The Hundred Continues
moments.blurb: The 100-ball cricket tournament, The Hundred, has multiple men's and women's matches today and throughout the week across the UK, with the final set for August 16th.

angles.name: Match Day Excitement
angles.copy: It's another exciting day in The Hundred! Who are you backing to win their matches today across the country?

angles.name: Welsh Fire Focus
angles.copy: Big week for Welsh Fire fans as The Hundred continues! Catch the action as teams battle it out for a spot in the finals.

angles.name: Cricket Summer
angles.copy: The summer of cricket is in full swing with The Hundred. Fast-paced action guaranteed all week, leading up to the final on August 16th.

moments.title: Super League Action This Week
moments.blurb: Rugby League's Betfred Super League Round 22 kicks off this Thursday, August 6th, with several key fixtures across the UK.

angles.name: Midweek Rugby Thrills
angles.copy: Super League is back this week! Round 22 kicks off Thursday with some massive clashes. Who are you rooting for?

angles.name: Yorkshire Derby Buzz
angles.copy: Huge week for Yorkshire rugby fans with Super League action. Get ready to cheer on your team!

moments.title: Boardmasters Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Boardmasters Festival returns to Watergate Bay and Fistral Beach in Newquay, Cornwall from August 5-9, featuring headliners like Fatboy Slim, The Kooks, and James Arthur.

angles.name: Cornwall Calling
angles.copy: Boardmasters starts this Wednesday! Who's heading down to Newquay for the surf, music, and festival vibes?

angles.name: Lineup Hype
angles.copy: Fatboy Slim, The Kooks, James Arthur – the Boardmasters lineup is stacked! Kicking off in Cornwall this Wednesday.

moments.title: Olivia Dean Breaks UK Chart Record
moments.blurb: Olivia Dean's duet with Sam Fender, 'Rein Me In,' has become the longest-running #1 hit in UK Official Singles Chart history, spending a total of 19 non-consecutive weeks at the top.

angles.name: Chart History Made
angles.copy: History made! Olivia Dean and Sam Fender's 'Rein Me In' is officially the UK's longest-running #1 single EVER. Incredible achievement!

angles.name: Love Song Legacy
angles.copy: A record-breaking love song! Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has etched its place in UK chart history. What a track.

moments.title: Happy 68th to Ian Broudie
moments.blurb: Ian Broudie, frontman of The Lightning Seeds and renowned music producer, turns 68 on August 4th.

angles.name: Lightning Seeds Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 68th birthday to Ian Broudie of The Lightning Seeds on August 4th! What's your favourite hit from him?

angles.name: Music Maestro
angles.copy: The man behind so many great tunes! Happy 68th birthday to Ian Broudie, an absolute legend of British music.

moments.title: A Flock Of Seagulls' Paul Reynolds at 64
moments.blurb: Paul Reynolds, the iconic lead guitarist for new wave band A Flock Of Seagulls, celebrates his 64th birthday on August 4th.

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 64th birthday to Paul Reynolds, the brilliant guitarist from A Flock Of Seagulls! What's your favourite 80s hit from the band?

angles.name: New Wave Wizard
angles.copy: From 'I Ran' to 'Space Age Love Song,' Paul Reynolds' guitar work defined a generation. Happy 64th!

moments.title: Paul Layton of The New Seekers Turns 79
moments.blurb: Paul Layton, the bassist and vocalist for the popular 70s group The New Seekers, celebrates his 79th birthday on August 4th.

angles.name: 70s Pop Star
angles.copy: Happy 79th birthday to Paul Layton from The New Seekers! Celebrate with us by enjoying one of their classic hits.

angles.name: Timeless Tunes
angles.copy: From 'I'd Like to Teach the World to Sing' to 'Circles,' Paul Layton helped create some unforgettable songs. Happy 79th birthday!

moments.title: Marques Houston Turns 45
moments.blurb: Marques Houston, known for his work with R&B group Immature (later IMx) and his solo career, celebrates his 45th birthday on August 4th.

angles.name: R&B Throwback
angles.copy: Remember Immature? Wishing a happy 45th birthday to Marques Houston, who gave us so many R&B jams!

angles.name: Solo & Group Success
angles.copy: From 'Sister, Sister' to chart-topping R&B, happy 45th birthday to Marques Houston! What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Mixed UK Weather, Drought Continues
moments.blurb: Early August brings mixed weather to the UK, with warmer, humid conditions and potential thunderstorms in England and Wales, while northern areas see cooler, wetter weather. Drought conditions persist across parts of England and all of Wales.

angles.name: August Outlook
angles.copy: Expect a mixed start to August across the UK – some areas seeing warmer, humid weather with thunderstorms, others cooler and wetter.

angles.name: Drought Update
angles.copy: Drought conditions continue across Wales and parts of England. Remember to use water wisely as the mixed weather pattern continues.

angles.name: Devon Forecast
angles.copy: Devon and the South West could see some warmer, humid spells and the chance of thunderstorms this week, but drought conditions remain.

moments.title: Summer School Holidays Ongoing
moments.blurb: School summer holidays are in full swing across the UK, with varying end dates: Wales schools finish around August 11th, while England and Scotland continue until the end of August.

angles.name: Holiday Fun
angles.copy: The summer holidays are well underway! What are your plans for the rest of August before the kids head back to school?

angles.name: Wales Back to School Soon
angles.copy: Enjoy the last week of summer holidays! Schools in Wales are due to return around August 11th.

angles.name: Scottish Summer
angles.copy: Making the most of the Scottish summer holidays! Still plenty of time for adventures before schools return at the end of August.

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield 2026, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup winners Manchester City, will take place on Sunday, August 16th, at Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: Curtain Raiser
angles.copy: The Premier League season's curtain-raiser, the Community Shield, is just two weeks away! Arsenal vs Man City in Cardiff.

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Big Match
angles.copy: Cardiff's Principality Stadium hosts the Community Shield on August 16th! Who's excited to see Arsenal and Man City battle it out in our capital?
